description: Positive expected value bets: FanDuel and DraftKings prices that pay more than the Novig fair (no-vig) probability, with EV%, edge in cents, Kelly stake, freshness and a confidence flag. Default view: fair probability at least 15%, main lines only, high confidence only, best EV first; override with min_prob, alt_lines, confidence and sort. Free keys read the top rows 10 minutes late; live rows need Developer. Costs 2 credits per 100 rows requested. Same data as GET /api/v1/ev. Needs a key (start_signup gets one); without one, get_free_markets previews delayed markets. Pass user_request: your user's current task in one sentence (3 to 500 characters, no secrets or personal data). It is saved so the team builds what people need.

alt_lines.description: Include alternate lines, not only the main line of each market. Default false.

books.description: Comma list of book codes: fd (FanDuel), dk (DraftKings).

league.description: League code, such as NBA or NFL.

limit.description: Rows per page, default 50. Free returns at most 100.

min_prob.description: Smallest Novig fair probability, percent. Default 15.

user_request.description: Your user's current task in one sentence. Saved for 35 days so the team can decide what to build. Leave out secrets and personal data.

name: find_ev_bets
